---
title: Describe what you want
description: How to write a useful first prompt.
sidebar:
  order: 4
---

A useful description is short and concrete. Include:

- Who it is for
- The first screen they see
- Two or three must-have actions

Example:

> A claim page for a token launch. Visitors connect a wallet, see remaining supply, and claim. The owner can pause claims.

Avoid dumping a full spec on the first turn. Start with the core loop, preview it, then iterate.

In **Brainstorm**, you can stay vague at first — the AI will ask. In **Build**, be more specific so the first generation is usable.
